coverage.scope_note: A complete docs page is not a complete website. R056 DOI metadata and two PDF chunks are one reference, not three. Only the four assigned priority IDs contribute to this worker's share of the 32-source target.

reading_status_definitions.full_page_read: Read the complete untruncated extracted document page, not linked sites or an entire documentation tree.
reading_status_definitions.full_paper_text_read: Read the complete publisher PDF extraction, including the continuation through references; not merely the landing-page abstract.
reading_status_definitions.selected_context_read: Read identified context or substantive page sections; not counted as a complete document.
reading_status_definitions.abstract_only: Read the author abstract and metadata; did not read the paper body.
reading_status_definitions.index_only: Read a publisher index to locate a dated publication; not an independent research finding.

sources.title: BNB Chain: Empowering the Future of Decentralized Applications
sources.relevance: Ecosystem taxonomy and compatibility context only. The page distinguishes BSC, opBNB and Greenfield; marketing speed/fee claims are not an independent finality distribution or evidence of a persistent cross-chain spread.
sources.triage: Retain as background; do not count generic EVM compatibility as shared security, instant settlement or a fresh 2026 instrument.

sources.title: What is BuilderNet
sources.relevance: Current documentation says builder nodes are not running in TEEs during a security-model transition, while backrunning and routing continue in TEEs. Shared orderflow and user refunds change access and the allocation of gross value.
sources.triage: High relevance. Do not project an older blanket TEE assumption onto all current components, or infer the transition date from this undated page.

sources.access_limit: Extraction was truncated amid large embedded documentation metadata. Only the substantive introduction, example warning and checkpoint context were used; no complete-page claim.

sources.title: Cancun-Deneb (Dencun) FAQ

sources.triage: Historical cost-regime break, not a newly launched instrument in the requested 2025-10-29 to 2026-10-29 window. No L2 round-trip or mainnet-gas price was measured.

sources.title: MEV Protection - Block MEV With Flashbots Protect RPC
sources.relevance: Private submission, refunds and revert-filtering are documented service properties, not a guarantee of entrant fills, universal privacy, atomic cross-chain execution or a free failed leg.
sources.triage: High relevance to orderflow visibility and revenue sharing. Treat any legitimate arbitrage conditional on actual permitted access and current rules; no front-running or sandwiching.

sources.title: EIP-7547: Inclusion lists
sources.data_window: Motivation includes an October 2023 block-production statistic; not reused as current data.
sources.relevance: An inclusion-list proposal illustrates the distinction between inclusion, execution ordering and promptness. The currently displayed Stagnant status is not a deployed guarantee.
sources.triage: Protocol-design context only. No claim about whether another inclusion-list design is activated on mainnet.

sources.title: Scalable and Probabilistic Leaderless BFT Consensus through Metastability
sources.relevance: Snow/Avalanche consensus context. Experimental confirmation latency in an abstract is not an asset-specific current mainnet settlement or bridge-completion bound.
sources.triage: Background only; no inference about present Avalanche instrument implementation, liquidity or cross-chain economic finality.

sources.title: Time Is Money: Strategic Timing Games in Proof-Of-Stake Protocols
sources.read_scope: Sections 1 through 5, discussion, captions and references through page 17; PDF continuation fetched at offset 50000. Chart images not visually audited.
sources.relevance: Competition, privileged proposer rights and network latency affect who captures gross economic value. The authors distinguish a theoretical incentive from evidence of intentional behavior in their historical sample.
sources.triage: Consensus-risk and durability context only. No timing-deviation strategy, attack reproduction, optimization recipe or current small-entrant return estimate is derived.

sources.source_type: Peer-reviewed paper landing page and reference list
sources.relevance: The author abstract identifies a gap between academic countermeasures and practitioner adoption. References and cited-by metadata locate related work, but do not establish deployed defenses.
sources.triage: Context and bibliography triage only; paper body not read. Do not count its taxonomy as an implementation audit or a new independent current-market dataset.
sources.access_limit: Landing-page extraction truncated after references/metadata. Author abstract was read; automated publisher summaries were not used as evidence.

sources.title: Health Factor & Liquidations
sources.relevance: Candidate 5 only: eligibility uses protocol Health Factor, with governance-set thresholds and position-dependent liquidation limits. Protocol-permitted liquidators repay debt and receive collateral plus an incentive; the documentation also describes strong competition.
sources.qualification_limit: No borrower addresses, account monitoring, oracle-event timing, bot implementation, protocol configuration reads or transaction submission. Rules in general documentation were not matched to any particular deployment.

sources.title: Aave V3 Overview
sources.relevance: Candidate 5 only: Health Factor depends on protocol-oracle values and accrued interest; liquidation thresholds and incentives are per reserve. Redeeming aTokens for underlying is subject to available unborrowed liquidity and any active borrow collateralization.
sources.qualification_limit: General protocol rules, not an audited-build/configuration match or confirmation that any liquidation collateral receipt is freely withdrawable.

sources.title: Compound III Docs | Liquidation
sources.relevance: Candidate 5 only: absorption transfers debt/collateral to protocol reserves and records caller points; potential governance compensation is not a promised cash bonus. Buying discounted collateral is a distinct economic action, subject to reserve-target conditions and protocol price feeds.
sources.qualification_limit: No execution, target accounts, collateral inventory or price-feed reads. No generic Aave-style bonus was assigned to Compound absorbers.
